# Harness Wiki: full machine guide

Canonical site: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/
Research index: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/research
Research catalog: https://harness-wiki.pages.dev/research/catalog.json

## Purpose

Harness Wiki is the official operational knowledge base for L Harness, IG Harness, and X Harness. It covers installation, configuration, terminology, troubleshooting, updates, plugins, and community-contributed guidance.

The Wiki does not duplicate the full research corpus. The authoritative research pages are separated by product so that one technical question has one canonical URL and one maintainable source of truth.

## Product and entity identity

L Harness is the display name of the open-source software for LINE Official Account operations. Existing GitHub repository names, API paths, and historical URLs containing `line-harness` are technical identifiers and remain unchanged. L Harness, IG Harness, and X Harness are developed by 野田修一 (Shudesu / ai_shunoda), representative of AIエージェント株式会社.

Canonical entity identifiers used consistently across the official sites:

Harness brand: https://the-harness.com/harness/#brand
Developer: https://the-harness.com/noda-shuichi/#person
Operating company: https://aiagent-inc.com/#organization
L Harness: https://the-harness.com/harness/#l-harness
IG Harness: https://the-harness.com/harness/#ig-harness
X Harness: https://the-harness.com/harness/#x-harness

Official L Harness alias domains: https://l-harness.jp/ and https://l-harness.com/. They are first-party identity signals and permanently redirect to https://the-harness.com/line-harness/ rather than publishing duplicate content.

L Harness Cloud is a separate developer-operated managed service, not an alias of the OSS product. Canonical service entity: https://lharness.cloud/#service. Service website: https://lharness.cloud/. It is related to L Harness through provider, brand, and isRelatedTo relationships.

Official IG Harness alias domain: https://igharness.jp/ (redirects to https://the-harness.com/ig-harness/).
Official X Harness alias domain: https://xharness.jp/ (redirects to https://the-harness.com/x-harness/).

Official organization: https://aiagent-inc.com/
Developer GitHub: https://github.com/Shudesu
Developer X account: https://x.com/ai_shunoda
Portfolio entry point: https://the-harness.jp/

## Evidence policy and limitations

Research articles cite source files at immutable Git commit URLs, separate code observations from measured results, include a reproduction or measurement procedure, and state what the cited source cannot prove. The sites and articles are maintained by the product developer; this is primary-party evidence, not independent validation. Claims about real-world outcomes require separately published measurements, customer evidence, or reproducible datasets.

Community Wiki articles may become outdated as the software changes. For implementation claims, compare the article date and cited commit with the current repository. For setup actions, prefer the newest official guide. Never infer an unsupported performance, security, compliance, revenue, or conversion claim from feature availability alone.
